cards.primary_evidence_excerpt: - Sk Hynix mainly traded in Korea - $SKHY lists in the US with limited shares, ~2.5% of the float (this is called ADR) ... If you convert 22.5% of the Korean supply to the US, that 20-50% premium is likely to go down

evidence.excerpt: - Sk Hynix mainly traded in Korea - $SKHY lists in the US with limited shares, ~2.5% of the float (this is called ADR) ... If you convert 22.5% of the Korean supply to the US, that 20-50% premium is likely to go down

For anyone watching the 25%+ premium in $SKHY versus SK Hynix's Korean shares: The ADRs and local shares become convertible on July 29. Should open the door for arbitrage and likely compress the ADR premium.

Kim Sunwoo of Meritz Securities: "This Is Not the Time to Sell Samsung Electronics and $SKHY" ... DRAM shortage will intensify in the second half of this year. H2 2026: suppliers can fulfill only 75%–80% of DRAM demand.
